trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all 54 other trophies in single-player; the platinum has no multiplayer or DLC requirement. Finish the story first, then clear the optional questlines, collectibles, challenges and 100% checklist. Leave this one as the final tick, because it unlocks only when the rest of the list is complete. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Treat the platinum as a final checklist, not a separate activity.
Check the trophy list after every cleanup session to see what is left.

steps.text: Earn every other trophy in the list; no multiplayer or DLC is required.
Finish the story, then sweep side content, collectibles and challenges.
Check the trophy list for any trophy you have not earned yet.
Claim the platinum after the other 54 have popped.
The official list has 55 offline trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, with no online trophies.
The roadmap rates the platinum 4/10 and about 200 hours.
There is no mission replay, so keep manual saves; the game allows 15 manual slots plus one autosave.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave them off for the platinum run.
The story takes 60-80 hours; the 100% checklist is unlocked afterward under Progress > Stats.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. It is an automatic story trophy and cannot be missed, so the only requirement is to keep following the campaign marker until the mission ends. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Follow the story marker instead of wandering into side content.
If the mission is not on your map yet, advance the main campaign.

steps.text: Start the Chapter 1 main mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the story marker and finish the mission's objectives.
Let the mission-complete screen appear; the trophy is automatic.
The end-of-mission screen lists Jason's House in Key Lento as the reward, and finishing that screen is what pops the trophy.
Gone Fishing is the 2nd main mission, set in Mariana County and given by Cal.
Gone Fishing starts immediately after the Prologue and is played as Jason.
Jason rescues Donnie from the Kingfishers gang in Pelican Valley, then flies the sea plane back to Brian's Marina.
The mission's only reward line is Jason's House in Key Lento; no cash or vehicle is listed.
Donnie is held in a shack inside the Kingfishers' camp, which you can clear without raising the alarm.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy registers after the first Chapter 2 mission, What’s in the Bag?, so do not expect it the moment the chapter's last job ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Play the chapter from start to finish without jumping between saves.
Use the pause menu to confirm which story objective is next.

steps.text: Complete the main story missions that make up Chapter 1.
Continue into Chapter 2 and start What’s in the Bag?.
Finish that mission to let the Chapter 1 trophy register.
Chapter 1 opens with Gone Fishing and closes with Discharge Time.
Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag?; that mission is the actual unlock trigger.
Chapter 1 also contains the named missions Down to Earth, Island Dreams and Feng Shui.
The Prologue is the 1st main mission and hands straight into Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear the Chapter 2 main story. The unlock lands after the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, rather than at the exact chapter boundary. It is story-bound and unmissable. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Finish each story mission before spending time on side activities.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter if you like replaying missions.

steps.text: Play through the main missions of Chapter 2.
Move on to Chapter 3 and complete Welcome to Vice City.
Confirm the trophy after that mission; it cannot be missed.
Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag? and runs through Moses, Daily Driver, Breakfast Run and Coffee Break.
Chapter 2 ends with Checking Out (Move to Vice City); the trophy does not pop at that boundary.
The unlock trigger is Welcome to Vice City, the first Chapter 3 main mission.
Breakfast Run is the 39th main mission, starts at Starlet Motel in Kelly County and rewards the Trust trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3's main story. The trophy pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing into Chapter 4. It is automatic and cannot be missed. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Do not restart from an old save unless you intend to replay the chapter.
Check the chapter progress before starting a long free-roam session.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 main missions.
Start Chapter 4 and complete Ocean Beach.
Complete Another Life to trigger the Chapter 3 trophy.
Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City and includes The Cartel Heist, Here, Kitty Kitty and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The Cartel Heist is the 74th main mission, starts in Vice City's Stockyard and pays $120,000.
Chapter 4 opens with Ocean Beach and then Another Life; the second of those triggers this trophy.
Chapter 3 also contains Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS and Credit Check, which unlock later robbery content.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the main story of Chapter 4. The trophy unlocks after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. It is automatic and cannot be missed. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Save before the chapter finale if you want to replay its action sequences.
Follow the story markers rather than searching for extra jobs first.

steps.text: Clear the Chapter 4 main missions.
Finish the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
Wait for the mission-complete screen; the trophy is automatic.
Chapter 4 opens with Ocean Beach and Another Life and includes Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
VCIA Takedown is the airport heist strand, starting with Making Gainz and ending with the titled mission.
Starting From Zero is the final Chapter 4 mission and the unlock point for this trophy.
The chapter also holds the optional That's Where The Money Is..., which unlocks large bank vaults.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final main mission of the story, Starting From Zero in Chapter 4. It is automatic and cannot be missed, and it arrives alongside the Chapter 4 completion trophy. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Bring full health, armor and ammunition before starting the finale.
Keep a save from before the final mission for ending-related cleanup.

steps.text: Play the campaign through Chapter 4.
Complete the final main mission, Starting From Zero.
Let the ending play out and the trophy register.
The final mission is Starting From Zero, the same Chapter 4 finale that unlocks Top Of The World, Ma.
Chapter 4 runs from Ocean Beach through VCIA Takedown, Headliners and Starting From Zero.
Chapter 5 opens afterward with Bird in the Hand, so the story continues past this trophy.
The trophy is story-bound and has no optional objective or difficulty requirement.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a main mission in Chapter 2. It is an automatic story trophy, so follow the campaign marker and finish the job. There is no optional step and no way to miss it. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Finish the mission objectives in one run rather than leaving midway.
Check the story marker if you cannot find the next mission.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 and start the main mission Breakfast Run.
Complete the mission's objectives.
Confirm the automatic trophy after the mission ends.
The end-of-mission screen confirms the Trust trophy along with personal vehicles for Jason and Lucia, which is the moment it pops.
Breakfast Run is the 39th main mission, starts at Starlet Motel in Kelly County and is played as Lucia.
It requires Slam Dunk and a call from Jason; the motel icon turns pink when it is ready.
The robbery route is Hank's Waffles diner, then a liquor store, then a thrift store.
The escape ends with a 2-star wanted level and the reward line gives Jason and Lucia personal vehicles.
Hank's Waffles is the first robbery, and each store gives a 1-minute timer.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. The trophy is automatic and cannot be missed. Keep following the story markers until the heist is finished. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Read the mission prompts before committing to an approach.
Do not restart the heist for bonus cash until the trophy has popped.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 and begin The Cartel Heist.
Finish the heist's story objectives.
Let the mission end; the trophy is automatic.
The end-of-mission screen shows the $120,000 payout and the Break the Bank trophy, confirming the trophy has popped.
The Cartel Heist is the 74th main mission, starts in Vice City's Stockyard and is given by Raul.
It requires Hidden Charges and the rest of Chapter 3's main missions before Raul calls.
The target is Sinfrontera National Bank; destroying all 3 cell towers leaves just under 11 minutes.
The reward line lists $120,000 and the Break the Bank trophy, so the payout and trophy pop together.
Karim's signal starts the bank move, and the crew secures the backup terminal before opening the vault.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child’s Play, a main mission in Chapter 4. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Play the campaign normally and the trophy will arrive at the end of the mission. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Let the mission's dialogue and prompts guide you to the next objective.
Keep a save before the mission if you want to replay it later.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and start Child’s Play.
Complete the mission's story objectives.
Confirm the trophy after the mission ends.
Child's Play is the Chapter 4 mission that rescues Rafa from kidnappers.
It follows Fresh Evidence (Meet Dre'Quan) in the Chapter 4 mission order.
Rafa's Kidnapping and Adventures in Babysitting precede the rescue.
Child's Play sits between the VCIA Takedown preparation missions in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. It is an automatic story trophy with no optional requirement. Finish the mission and the trophy will register. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Stay with the mission until the results screen appears.
Check your story progress if the mission seems to be missing.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and begin Headliners.
Follow the story objectives to the end of the mission.
Let the mission-complete screen trigger the trophy.
Headliners is the Chapter 4 mission described as Help With The Launch Party.
It comes after VCIA Takedown's Delivery Method and Team Building in the mission list.
Tie Up Loose Ends follows Headliners, before the optional bank mission and Sunset.
The Chapter 4 route ends with Starting From Zero after Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a main mission in Chapter 4. The trophy is automatic and cannot be missed. Keep the campaign moving and finish the mission. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Do not confuse this story mission with the free-roam airport stunt.
Finish the mission in one sitting to avoid losing progress.

steps.text: Reach the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
Complete its story objectives.
Confirm the trophy when the mission ends.
VCIA Takedown is the airport heist strand in Chapter 4.
The strand starts with Making Gainz (Meet Raul) and Blood Sweat and Gear.
It includes Too Much Baggage (Scope Out the Airport) and Close Surveillance.
The titled VCIA Takedown mission starts the airport heist, followed by Tie Up Loose Ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 main mission. It is an automatic story trophy and cannot be missed. Finish the mission to keep the campaign moving toward the finale. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Stock up on health and armor before starting the operation.
Follow the objective prompts instead of exploring during the mission.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 5 and start Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission's story objectives.
Let the mission end and the trophy register.
Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission.
Chapter 5 opens with Bird in the Hand and Taking Liberties before Operation Savage Glory.
Doggie Bag (Meet Vinny) and VC Baby (Talk to Mattia) come earlier in Chapter 5.
Honest Abe, Unfinished Business and The End of the Road follow the trophy mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion after the story; the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and campaign progress already counts. Nothing is missable and one playthrough is enough, but there is no mission replay or New Game+, so keep manual saves for story moments. The completion list includes 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 Target Decks, every meditation spot, all robberies, shooting ranges and drone races. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Finish the story first so every activity and area is available.
Use the in-game completion checklist to avoid redoing finished categories.
Clean up one category at a time instead of jumping between them.

steps.text: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Scan 200 of the 277 base vehicles and study 100 of the 255 animals.
Complete 70 of 80 challenges and every meditation spot.
Clear all 15 Target Decks, all robberies, shooting ranges and drone races.
Finish all 100 optional missions; one playthrough is enough.
The checklist wants 100 optional tasks, 39 of 39 gang operations and 22 of 22 bank jobs.
It also wants 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs, 50 of 91 Stick Ups and 8 of 8 vaults.
Exploration targets include 30 of 40 races, 42 of 42 shooting medals and 42 of 42 drone races.
The story has 5 chapters and the platinum takes about 200 hours, with 100% closer to 60% true completion.
The five counties are Mariana, Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly and Lummox.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, drawn from any mix of the four categories: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. There are 397 in total, so pick the fastest types and repeat them. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so you will pass this trophy on the way. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use open roads and stunt-friendly terrain while travelling between jobs.
Check trophy progress periodically so you know how many remain.

steps.text: Open the map and filter for stunts, then pick the quickest category.
Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts.
Keep going to 300 if you are also chasing 100% completion.
Mix Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps.
The 397 stunts split into 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps.
Stunt Jumps include Mile Zero Air Station Southeast, Saltrock Bridge West and Key Lento Bridge East.
Kelly County holds 29 Stunt Jumps, including the Gellhorn International Raceway and Starlet Motel Construction.
Trophy progress can be tracked by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots lists found and completed stunts by their unique names.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. The tracker under Touchpad > Progress > Activities shows how many of each you have done, and the map's Activities filter helps you find the rest. Most types appear through the story or as you unfog the map. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use the map's activity icons to spot categories you have not tried.
A quick attempt counts, so do not grind gold medals for this one.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the nine types.
Complete at least one activity of each type.
Use the map's Activities filter to find the missing types.
Check the tracker again after unfogging new areas.
The nine types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, racing and stunts.
Most types are introduced by the main story; the rest appear when you unfog the map.
The map's blue dumbbell filter marks the activity locations.
A single attempt at each type is enough; no gold medal or win threshold is required.
Basketball, pool and golf are easy one-attempt fills on the same activity list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal at every Shooting Range challenge. There are 12 Shooting Range locations and 42 gold medals in total, and all of them are needed for the trophy. The 100% checklist also requires the full shooting-range sweep. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Learn each challenge's scoring rule before spending time on repeat runs.
Replay a challenge immediately after a poor run while the layout is fresh.

steps.text: Find the 12 Shooting Range locations on the map.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
Replay a range if a challenge is not gold yet.
Finish every range for the 100% checklist as well.
There are 2 ranges: Griffin in north-west Vice City and Rodgers Ranch in north-east Port Gellhorn.
Griffin has 6 courses with 3 gold medals each, for 18 of the 42.
Rodgers Ranch has 6 courses with 4 gold medals each, for the other 24.
Buy a $5 Waiver Pass from each clerk to mark the challenges; rented weapons cost $10.
Griffin's courses are 3-Point, Hook, Loop, Maze, Compound and Villa; Rodgers has Market, Zombie, Hunting, Saloon, Cops & Robbers and Alien.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has three races, for 42 in total, and the third race unlocks after you beat par on the first two. One win per location is enough for the trophy. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Win each location once and mark it off before moving on.
Practice the route after a loss so the next attempt is cleaner.

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each location.
Beat par on the first two races to unlock the third at each site.
Use the 42 races to cover all 14 locations.
Each of the 14 locations has 3 time trials, making 42 races.
You must beat par on the first 2 races at a location to unlock its third.
The locations include Hamlet, Watson Bay, Capri, Buckskin Swamp, Balsero and Downtown.
Dalton Island is only reachable by boat or aircraft, unlike the other locations.
The remaining locations are Vice Beach, Waning Sands, Ambrosia, Port Gellhorn, Draper Island, Moreau Sawmill and Millport.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can choose the events you find easiest and ignore the rest. Check the in-game race markers as you open the map. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Keep a written or in-game list of the races you have already won.
Use a vehicle that fits the race type instead of a random pickup.

steps.text: Open the map and find the race markers.
Win 20 different races.
Pick from the 40 unique race locations; repeats do not count.
There are 40 unique race locations, so winning 20 leaves 20 optional.
Hit 'N Run VC supplies 9 races: Salton 3, La Perle 2, Ocean Beach 2 and Gloriana Key 2.
Animal Crackers adds 8 races across Grayson, Redshaw's, Ranchers and Big Pine.
Gellhorn International Raceway adds 11 races after the Gellhorn Raceway Introduction.
Boone Speedway adds 2 races in Hamlet, Ambrosia Raceway 2, and Thrillbilly Mud Club 8.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After Chapter 1's main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot marked west of Key Lento; go there and win the challenge. The quest remains available after the story. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Watch the challenge's scoring rule before you start casting.
If the first attempt goes badly, retry rather than waiting for a new opportunity.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text marking the fishing spot west of Key Lento.
Go to the purple icon and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.
Feng Shui (Meet Cal) is a Chapter 1 main mission.
Cal's challenge is a purple side-task icon on the map, not a main-story marker.
The fishing spot is west of Key Lento.
Cal's Chapter 1 strand is listed as Catch a Bigger Fish but does not count as a Strangers & Freaks strand.
Cal's text arrives some time after Feng Shui, not during the mission.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, though some story sections lock the TV temporarily. The fourth is found elsewhere and counts just the same. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Pick the shortest or easiest arcade game you can find.
Do not leave the machine until the game's completion screen appears.

steps.text: Use the controllers at the home TV in Chapter 1.
Pick Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind.
Finish the arcade game to unlock the trophy.
If the TV is locked by a story section, come back later.
The 4 games are Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first 3 play on the JoySystem console at the TV in your home.
Bang For Your Buck is only on arcade machines, such as outside Bargain World in Port Gellhorn.
Reach the end of one game; beating every challenge is not required.
All 4 games count toward the 100% checklist, but only one needs to be finished for the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's five-quest chain. The chain is marked during Chapter 3 while playing as Lucia: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Start with Climbing the Cellerichain and finish all five jobs; they remain available after the story. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Finish Andy's earlier jobs before starting other long side strands.
Check the map for a side-mission marker if the strand seems to stall.

steps.text: Play Chapter 3 as Lucia and take Andy's call.
Use the texted Belville address to open the questline.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain and the other four Andy jobs.
Come back after the story if you missed the chain.
Andy's chain is Lucia-only and marked in Belville during Chapter 3.
The five jobs are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse) is the final mission that awards the trophy.
The chain remains available after the story, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's questline. The chain appears in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton): he calls, then his green KR icon shows in Key Lento. His treasure-diving jobs mark shipwrecks with purple chest icons, and all of them stay available after the story. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Work through Kenton's jobs in order instead of skipping ahead.
Use the map's side-mission markers to find the next job.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1's Island Dreams (Work for Kenton).
Take Kenton's call and find the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and finish his final mission.
Return after the story if the chain is still open.
Kenton's chain is marked after Island Dreams by a green KR icon in Key Lento.
He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared for his questline.
Track the chain under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
After Chapter 1 Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable, then returns during Chapters 2-3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's five-job chain. It appears after Chapter 2's Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, starting with Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club). The other jobs include Twist Wrist, Smash Grab and Mall Rats, and the chain remains available after the story. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Do not start the final job until you are ready to finish the strand.
Check the map for a side-mission marker if Billy's jobs stop appearing.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish Thrillbillies and the rest of Billy's five jobs.
Return after the story if you have not finished the chain.
Billy's chain is marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break.
The five jobs are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job) is the final mission that awards the trophy.
Mall Rats is marked solo-only in the walkthrough, while the chain stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. These side quests remain after the story, so they are safe to leave for cleanup. Keep your criminal profile below Irredeemable, because that rating is permanent and makes police more aggressive; the Jason–Lucia relationship status does not affect the trophy. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Track completed strands so you do not repeat the same one.
Sweep the map for stranger icons after the story opens up more of Leonida.

steps.text: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida.
Use the map's stranger markers to find the remaining strands.
Finish them after the story if you prefer; they do not expire.
Avoid the permanent Irredeemable criminal profile while doing them.
Only certain strands count; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.
Kirk's strand is Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies and Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Kyle's strand is Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle and Buddy?.
Yago's strand includes Join a Street Race and Bumper to Bumper; Pilot Pete's starts with The Last Mile.
Pilot Pete's strand is The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot and Pete's Deliveries.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's Wish List. The chain opens after Chapter 3's Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also gives you the Key Cloner. Randy then lists 16 sports cars to deliver; the chain stays open after the story. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Finish Randy's earlier jobs before moving to another strand.
Check the map for the next marker if the strand appears to stop.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3's Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy).
Open Randy's Wish List and read the 16-car request.
Steal and deliver all 16 sports cars.
Finish the final delivery to close the chain.
Randy's green RK icon is in the west of Vice City, and the list lives under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS also unlocks the Key Cloner used for later car thefts.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check the wishlist, then deliver them in good condition for more pay.
The 16 cars include the Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Grotti Itali RSX and Bravado Banshee.
Randy marks some wishlist cars automatically, and delivering those reveals new locations.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's questline. It opens after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty and is available only while playing as Jason. Destroy the purple-marked Synthetic Labs in Vice City during Take Out Kitty Litter, then finish the chain; everything remains available after the story. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Complete Tyrone's jobs in sequence rather than jumping around.
Check the map for a side-mission marker if the next job is missing.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty as Jason.
Follow the purple Synthetic Labs markers in Vice City.
Destroy the labs during Take Out Kitty Litter.
Finish the final Tyrone mission after the story if needed.
There are 14 Kitty Litter labs, and destroying one pays $2,000 or $2,500 via BuckMe.
The story lab is a trailer with pink smoke and yellow tubes; other labs sit in garages and buildings.
After enough labs, Tyrone starts Spin on This (Shut Down the Labs), the final mission.
Labs are not missable and can still be destroyed in free-roam after the story.
Tyrone's labs are purple search areas; the pink gas marks the building to destroy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. The first one, at Jason's house in Chapter 1 after Down to Earth, may not register as a Meditation Spot, so it is the one potentially missable step; save first and check the tracker. Every other spot remains available in free-roam, and the 100% checklist wants all of them. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use the map's activity markers to find meditation spots.
Sweep one region at a time so you do not miss a spot.

steps.text: Save before the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house after Down to Earth.
Check that the first meditation registers as a Meditation Spot.
Find and complete every remaining meditation spot in Leonida.
Sweep the map region by region after the story.
There are 18 meditations across 10 spots; doing one with both Jason and Lucia counts +2.
The Chapter 1 spot is Jason's house balcony, available in the morning after Down to Earth.
Named spots include Smooth Sand off Capri, Swamp in Buckskin Swamp and Worn Stone at Camp Moonflower.
The final Ascent Mountain meditation appears at Mount Kalaga only after the other spots are done.
Meditation progress is under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and the map filter Meditate Around Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His chain opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break with a text only Jason receives; the first job, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), is in Lummox County, and later he marks purple hunting spots for specific animals. The chain stays open after the story, and the 100% checklist wants all 15 Bret hunts. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Make a manual save before beginning Bret's hunt.
Bring a suitable weapon and do not abandon the tracking phase.
Reload rather than risk losing the unique target if the attempt fails.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Switch to Jason and read Bret's text marking Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret).
Visit Bret in Lummox County and complete his first hunt.
Hunt the requested animals at the purple spots and return them to Bret.
Finish all 15 Bret hunts for the 100% checklist.
Bret is Jason-only; his text arrives after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) gives the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle, retrievable from Ammu-Nations lockers.
A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required.
There are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: The official description asks for three complete Collectible Card sets. Our 100% research also tracks the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck, and the completion checklist requires all of them. Clear the decks while you sweep the map so the same passes serve both targets. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Focus on three sets that are already close to complete.
Check the collection menu after each pickup to confirm the set count.

steps.text: Open Map > Activities > Target Deck to see the deck list.
Complete all 15 Target Decks during your map sweep.
Confirm the decks are done; 100% completion requires them too.
There are 18 Collectible Card Sets holding 480 unique cards.
The trophy needs 3 complete sets; the 100% checklist needs 15.
Named sets include Vice City Flamingos (24 cards), Vice City Narcos (24) and Vice City Manatees (24).
Completing 15 sets needs at least 372 of the 480 cards, because set sizes differ.
Cards can be sold at any pawn shop but stay in Collections, so selling does not break set progress.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with WAiNK. There are more than 100 available, so any 100 count; the guide's split is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags. Scan what you pass while exploring and the trophy will arrive at 100. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use WAiNK It whenever you reach a new area instead of passing it by.
Track your count so you do not waste time revisiting old spots.

steps.text: Hold the WAiNK scan control while looking at a scannable object.
Scan any 100 locations; there are more than 100 in Leonida.
Scan the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures.
Add No Flusher tags to reach the 100 total.
The scans come in 5 sets: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags.
No Flusher Tags are spray-paint markings on the ground in city areas.
AHOL Street Art and 1010 Murals use the same scan but do not count toward the 100.
A nearby scan gives a controller vibration and a bottom-right prompt before you hold the scan app.
The five sets are Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures, an unknown set and No Flusher Tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in the game, so pick the 50 you find quickest; the 100% checklist asks for any 70 of the 80. The pause menu tracks them under Progress > Challenges, where the Completed checkmark shows what is done. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Check the challenge list before long drives so you can combine objectives.
Knock out easy challenges while travelling between main activities.

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges and sort by what is close to done.
Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
Reach 70 of 80 if you are also finishing the 100% checklist.
Use the Completed checkmark to track each one.
The 80 challenges are split into 8 categories of 10.
Combat challenges include Speed Kills (3 enemies in 30 seconds) and Headshots (4 in one Combat Focus).
Exploration challenges include Skyscrapers (5 tallest towers) and Collectible Cards in all 5 counties.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, leaving 10 skippable challenges.
Criminal challenges include Mugging (5 pedestrians) and Cop Car Theft (5 minutes in a stolen cruiser).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while playing with your partner. Free-roam together unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call the other character. Cause enough chaos to reach four stars, then break line of sight and escape; an armored vehicle helps. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Reach four stars before committing to the escape route.
Stay close to your partner so the trophy condition is not broken.
Avoid getting busted while the wanted level is still active.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break to unlock partner free-roam.
Call your partner and stay together in free-roam.
Reach a four-star wanted level.
Escape the police while your partner is with you.
The 4-star escape is easiest through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, not when you clear the blue/red search circle.
Large bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star level, so That's Where The Money Is... can unlock it automatically.
Call your partner by holding the interaction button; partner free-roam opens after Coffee Break.
If a helicopter chases you, shoot it down; a fast sports motorcycle is the recommended escape vehicle.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing the wanted level. This becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Hit three green robbery targets while the police are chasing you and keep the red-and-blue wanted meter alive between shops; an armored vest and sticky bombs make it safer. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Plan a short route between the three shops before starting.
Do not stop to lose the police until the third robbery is done.
Keep your partner with you for the whole streak.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break and bring your partner.
Rob a green shop target and keep the police chase active.
Rob two more shops before the wanted level clears.
Use an armored vest and sticky bombs to survive the run.
The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
The 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City are available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Keep the blue/red flashing wanted level, not the red heat level, across all three robberies.
Rob a few items and break the back-room safe in each store so the robbery counts.
If the trophy does not pop after the third shop, rob a fourth and keep the chase alive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The game has 557 at launch, and scanning with WAiNK is the quickest route: stand by a busy road and scan each new model that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base vehicles. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Get into every unfamiliar vehicle you pass during free roam.
Use the in-game vehicle list to target models you have not discovered.

steps.text: Hold the WAiNK scan control while looking at a vehicle.
Stand at a busy road and scan every new model that passes.
Discover 100 different vehicles.
Reach 200 of the 277 base vehicles for the 100% checklist.
GTA VI ships with 557 vehicles, including cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes.
Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive the vehicle to discover it.
Different regions spawn different models: supercars at Ocean Beach hotels, trucks in Port Gellhorn, basic cars in Key Lento.
Check Progress > Vehicles to see category totals.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Activate Focus with the shoulder buttons while aiming; it slows time and highlights weak spots, but only for a few seconds. Build the purple focus meter first and start the fight with five targets nearby. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Start Combat Focus only when several enemies are already in view.
Aim for body shots that are easy to land rather than risky headshots.
If the group is too small, wait for a larger encounter.

steps.text: Fill the purple Combat Focus meter below health and stamina.
Aim at a group of at least five enemies.
Activate Combat Focus with the shoulder buttons.
Take down five enemies before the Focus bar empties.
Combat Focus slows time and highlights enemy weak spots, and drains the purple bar.
The bar only lasts a few seconds, so Adrenaline can extend the window.
Criminals at Gang Operations count; soldiers, police and civilians do not.
The Duke 556 assault rifle and body armor from Ammu-Nations make the 5-kill run safer.
Focus has 4 levels, shown under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia; shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane from a VCIA departure terminal and take off without permission. Use a plane attached to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip and fly out. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Treat this as a free-roam experiment, not a story mission.
Try leaving the airport by a route that is clearly not a normal flight.

steps.text: Go to VCIA and find a plane attached to a departure bridge.
Climb upstairs and enter the cockpit.
Reverse the plane onto the airstrip.
Take off to trigger the unscheduled departure.
The target plane is docked at departure terminal E3/E4 at VCIA.
Passenger planes parked on the airfield do not work; it must be attached to a boarding bridge.
Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport before the delayed trophy pops.
Enter through the fence and boarding-bridge stairs, or on foot through the terminal.
Going over the airfield fence is faster than walking through the terminal.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of Mariana County. The tanks sit in the south of the base; drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Once inside, shoot a few enemies. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Check the in-game trophy hints if the description is not clear enough.
Look for a tank-related free-roam opportunity rather than a story job.

steps.text: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Enter the base through the gate or the south-east stunt jump.
Steal a tank from the south side of the base.
Shoot enemies until the trophy appears.
Mile Zero Air Station sits on an island at the south-west edge of Mariana County.
The tanks are parked in the south of the air base.
You can drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Shoot enemies after taking the tank; the trophy is not tied to a mission.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry-store robberies; the stores then appear as green icons. Pick a back door, open it with the Snap Gun and clear the job quietly. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Scout the store before starting the robbery.
Silence alarms and avoid guards instead of fighting through.
Restart immediately if you are detected.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3's Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs.
Find a green jewelry-store robbery icon on the map.
Open the back door with the Snap Gun.
Finish the robbery without being detected.
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed doors.
The back room holds a note with the safe code; use it to open the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before leaving.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and the trophy pops shortly after you exit.
The Snap Gun stays in inventory permanently after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, so no equip step is needed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. The Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) introduces the vault job and counts as the first one. Tail a security van, follow the guard with the briefcase and clear five vaults in total. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Finish each vault and escape before starting the next one.
Plan an exit route before you enter the vault.
Keep a vehicle ready for the getaway.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4's That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Tail a security van to a bank and follow the guard inside.
Rob the first vault during the mission.
Repeat until you have robbed five bank vaults and escaped.
There are 8 large bank vaults; the trophy needs any 5, while the 100% checklist needs all 8.
After the intro mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips if his earlier jobs are done.
Bring your partner and hand off a bag when you cannot carry more.
Each vault pays up to $205,000 and triggers a 4-star wanted level.
Yasmani's security-van tips mark the vans with a purple icon.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) unlocks this robbery type; tail the truck, then follow the guard carrying the cash. Robbing a large bank vault counts as the armored-truck job too. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Pick a stretch of road where you can stop the truck cleanly.
Have a getaway vehicle ready before you start the robbery.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4's That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Tail an armored truck until it stops at a bank.
Follow the guard with the cash and take the score.
Escape; a large bank-vault robbery also counts.
The intro mission is That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe) at the end of Chapter 4.
A large-bank vault robbery also counts as robbing an armored truck.
Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray to finish the robbery.
An earlier method is to sticky-bomb an armored truck's rear door; Yasmani's shop stocks the bombs.
Large-bank robberies also give 4-star wanted levels, so plan the escape before entering.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal the whole map by clearing every patch of black fog. Flying a plane over the remaining areas is the fastest method. Keep going until no fog is left anywhere in Leonida. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use the pause-menu map to find regions you have not entered.
Sweep the map in large loops instead of revisiting familiar areas.

steps.text: Get a plane and fly over the map's black fog.
Sweep every region until the fog clears.
Check the map for any remaining dark patch.
The game has no mission replay, so unfogging after the story is the safe cleanup route.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total, but the trophy only needs one per gang; the 100% checklist needs all 39. Yellow icons mark them as you get close, and story progress reveals many. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Track which gangs you have already robbed.
Escape cleanly after each operation before moving to the next gang.

steps.text: Find the yellow illegal-operation icons on the map.
Rob at least one operation for each of the nine gangs.
Use story progress to reveal more operations.
Clear all 39 operations if you are finishing the 100% checklist.
There are 9 gangs and 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total.
One operation per gang is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist needs all 39.
19 of the 39 operations are revealed automatically by story progress.
Track the count per gang under Progress > Gangs; the bottom right shows operations robbed.
Many gang operations are marked automatically from story progress; the rest appear near their location.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and drink it beside the bar. The trophy is about the view as much as the drink, so stay on the rooftop while you finish it. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Look for a beachfront venue with a view rather than an interior bar.
Check the map for a bar icon if you cannot find the right spot.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) before the car can be hacked. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Get fully inside the showroom before accelerating at the glass.
Pick a sturdy vehicle so the exit does not stall.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3's Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy).
Go to the showroom in south Vice City.
Hack the blue Banshee with the Key Cloner.
Drive it through the showroom window.
The target is the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City.
Only that specific blue Banshee counts; other cars do not trigger the trophy.
The Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS is required to hack the car.
The trophy pops after you drive farther down the street; it is a GTA III easter egg.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Finish the Kolt & Associates bowling-alley job in Port Gellhorn. It is the Kingpin Bowling gang operation from Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring Sticky Bombs from an Ammu-Nation to destroy the safe, and steal all three key valuables. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use the map's bowling marker if you cannot find the alley.
Finish a full game rather than leaving after one throw.

steps.text: Buy Sticky Bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
Start Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling.
Use the Sticky Bombs to destroy the safe and finish the job.
Kingpin Bowling is a gang operation in Port Gellhorn, marked in Chapter 2.
The three valuables are the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east table and the safe in the north-east hallway.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item.
If you miss an item during Hit Kingpin Bowling, the robbery respawns later; you can split the three across visits.
The trophy only checks the 3 valuables and the police escape; killing the bowling-alley enemies is optional.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise the strength stat to maximum on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Free-roam switching unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; work out with each character and check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength. You need both bars full before the trophy counts. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Follow partnership-focused story and side content rather than avoiding it.
Check the in-game trophy hints if it has not popped by the endgame.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break to unlock character switching.
Work out as Jason until his Strength is maxed.
Work out as Lucia until her Strength is maxed.
Check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength for both.
Both Jason and Lucia must be at maximum Strength at the same time.
Buy a fitness-club membership and call your partner so both train together.
The partner completes their training automatically while you work out, doubling progress.
After the story you can also work out at home, and the map's dumbbell filter finds fitness clubs.
Strength is the heart icon under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia; max it for both characters.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy checklist shows the count, and turning on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications makes each qualifying action visible with a demon icon. This is a long cumulative trophy rather than a single job. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Keep a manual save before every major story decision.
Do not overwrite that save until the trophy has popped.
If a choice-dependent trophy is missing, replay from an earlier branch.

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Perform actions that affect your criminal profile.
Open the trophy list to check your progress out of 500.
Keep going until all 500 actions are counted.
The five profile bands are Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Stealth and clean robberies build Professional; limb shots build Hardened; kills build Violent.
Irredeemable is permanent and makes police more aggressive, so avoid it if you want quieter cleanup.
Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, and running over civilians or cops is a fast farm.
The demon face appears on the HUD's right side whenever one of the 500 profile actions registers.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is still unknown. The trophy guide connects it to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again in a specific way at the Little Cuba location in Vice City. Treat this as a lead to test, not a confirmed route. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use the in-game retry option instead of reloading a manual save.
Pick a repeatable activity where failure is quick and easy to recover from.

steps.text: Note the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
Return to the Little Cuba location in Vice City.
Try robbing the store again in a different way.
The exact trigger is unknown, so treat this as a lead.
The trophy's reward line is 'Second time's the charm.'

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO Easter Egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Go solo at night after 2AM; the event is random, so a blinking car may or may not be waiting. If it is not there, drive away and return. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Follow unusual free-roam encounters instead of driving past them.
Check the in-game trophy hints if it has not triggered by the endgame.

steps.text: Travel alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel.
Arrive after 2AM at night.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside.
If it is missing, drive away and come back.
Trigger the UFO when the blinking car appears.
The spot is on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
You must arrive solo at night after 2AM; the spawn is random, not guaranteed.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO and talk to the woman it drops.
Walk her back to the car at the roadside to end the easter egg.
The UFO is a bright blue light in the sky, and the woman asks you to return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Drive any bike and kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds. Crowded streets in Vice City or at Ocean Beach give you the easiest targets. Keep moving and chain the kicks quickly. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Slow down alongside the target before swinging.
Use a melee attack from the vehicle rather than a firearm.

steps.text: Get on any bike and ride into a crowded area.
Kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds.
Try Vice City or Ocean Beach for dense crowds.
The count is 10 pedestrians, and the window is 60 seconds.
Any bike works; the kick is a melee drive-by attack.
Vice City and Ocean Beach have the dense crowds you need.
The description 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' confirms the kick, not a vehicle collision, is what counts.
The 60-second clock makes a dense district better than a quiet road.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through a Fence. Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Launder marked bills as you earn them instead of spending them.
Check the trophy progress to see how much of the total remains.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew).
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect Marked Bills.
Deliver $250,000 in Marked Bills to a Fence.
Use Yasmani in Vice City for the best payout.
Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering Marked Bills.
The $250,000 counts across all robberies, so you do not need to deliver it at once.
Yasmani in Vice City pays the most for the bills.
Large bank vaults can give up to $205,000 in one robbery once That's Where The Money Is... is done.
A single large bank can supply up to $205,000 once That's Where The Money Is... unlocks vaults.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops. The total is cumulative and any shop type counts; guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they cost more. The guide's shop counts include 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores and 14 mod shops. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Spread purchases across several shops instead of one store.
Check the trophy progress before making a large purchase.

steps.text: Buy guns, car mods or tattoos to spend quickly.
Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types.
Use the 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and 24 Ammu-Nations.
Add clothing, footwear, salons and electronics if needed.
The fast spend is guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive shop types.
There are 67 clothing stores, 24 Ammu-Nations and 19 Pay 'n' Sprays in Leonida.
The other counts are 14 mod shops, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
The $100,000 is cumulative across all shop types, not a single purchase.
A mix of mods, guns and tattoos is fine; each purchase adds to the same $100,000 total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages. The four story garages do not count; the eight you need cost $160,000 in total. They unlock after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when Vice City Real Estate appears on your phone. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Use the property list to see which garages are still unowned.
Check the property menu after each purchase to confirm it counted.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
Open Vice City Real Estate on your phone.
Buy all eight purchasable garages.
Budget $160,000; the four story garages do not count.
There are 12 garages total: 8 purchasable and 4 story-related.
Only the 8 purchasable garages count, and they cost $160,000 combined.
Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) installs Vice City Real Estate on the phone.
Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to fund the $160,000.
The four story garages are free progression rewards and do not count toward the eight purchases.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); each garage adds parking spots, so buy enough garages first. Register stolen vehicles and they can be delivered to you anywhere. This is our own reading of the official description and the cited pages, not a playthrough.
tips: Register each new vehicle as soon as you acquire it.
Use the app's list to avoid registering the same vehicle twice.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Buy garages from Little Boxes to open parking spots.
Register stolen vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
Reach 10 registered vehicles.
Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) installs Scooter Bros on the phone.
Drive stolen cars to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Each garage adds one or more parking spots, so Little Boxes comes first.
Chapter 3 adds Standard Tracker cars and lets you register at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Each registration costs money, so register 10 cheap cars or bikes rather than supercars.
